query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT status, created_at, id FROM contacts WHERE (status = $1) AND partner_id = $2 AND ((created_at, id) > ($5, $4)) AND ($4 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $3) UNION ALL (SELECT status, created_at, id FROM contacts WHERE (status = $1) AND partner_id = $2 AND ($4 IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $3) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $3) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $6 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN contact_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.created_at asc, i.id asc, i.id, e.sequence
